thread:
alana.w: FYI onboarding campaign pushed ~7.1k signups. we're seeing enrichment timeouts and RR allocator is repeatedly assigning same 3 reps. SLA alarms firing.

trent.p: which workflow and sample error?

alana.w: wf id: onboarding-flow-2026-v1. sample error: POST /enrich status=504 latency=15s lead=L-3320. many leads show assigned in HubSpot but never land in Salesforce.

hubspot-bot: [ALERT] workflow=onboarding-flow-2026-v1 enrichment_timeouts=398 pending_assignments=920 assign_retries_spike=true

cory.j: quick hypothesis 44 allocator retries while enrichment callback still processing, causing duplicate claims and owner skew. also see webhook 429s from enrich service.

janet.s: short-term mitigations: enable an "onboarding-flowback" fallback pool for campaign=="onboarding-2026", attach a minimal profile if enrichment >7s, and raise claim_heartbeat 30s->85s to prevent hot reclaims. disable immediate retry-on-fail for 10s window.

trent.p: agree. runbook steps:
- set fallback_owner = onboarding-flowback-pool for campaign onboarding-2026
- fastpath threshold = 7s, attach minimal profile {email, name, campaign}
- claim_heartbeat = 85s for wf onboarding-flow-2026-v1
- add alert pending_assignments > 400 and owner_skew_ratio > 2.5

ops-bot: creating incident INC-2026-920, assignees: trent.p, cory.j

alana.w: deploying 3% canary now for the fallback and heartbeat change. will monitor owner distribution and CRM visibility.

hubspot-bot: rollout started: onboarding-flowback-canary -> 3%

cory.j: sample slow webhook:
```
POST /enrich HTTP/1.1
Host: enrich.redwood.ai
Body: {"leadId":"L-3320","email":"tara@example.com"}
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"retry_after":18}
```

janet.s: medium/long-term fixes: make allocator deterministic by hashing on external_id+campaign, add a tiny distributed lease (100ms) during enrichment callback to prevent concurrent claims, and dead-letter leads to CRM after 4 failed assigns with automated backfill. also surface per-campaign burst protection in console.

trent.p: metrics after 4m on canary: pending_assignments 920 -> 110, assign_retries_rate 24% -> 6%, crm_visible_rate within 10m improved 78% -> 94%.

alana.w: good improvement. rolling to 100% in 12m if stable. please notify sales: leads in fallback pool may have reduced enrichment fields for ~1h.

sales-bot: notifying @sales-team: temporary onboarding fallback active for campaign onboarding-2026. expect reduced enrichment detail for leads in fallback pool.

janet.s: follow-ups: add an automated rollback if crm_noop_rate > 1.5%, add a console flag to enable flowback per-campaign, and schedule postmortem to harden allocator determinism. filing tickets now.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-920 status=monitoring next_check=5m

cory.j: :thumbsup:
